events.outcome: Legacy GEL2/year was a rough estimate. Current official unit pricing and 90-day lifecycle imply a lower theoretical paid-action floor, but passive incoming SMS should not be relied on as the reset action.

data.acquisitionSummary: Cellfie lists prepaid SIM acquisition online and supports eSIM purchase. Current official web pricing shows a zero-GEL SIM line item with plan selection; shop pricing may differ.

keep.action: Perform a qualifying transaction before 90 days of non-use. The official lifecycle page restarts the 90-day clock after calls/service purchases or similar transactions; use an outgoing paid action rather than relying on passive SMS receipt.

data.chinaActivation: Local registration/acquisition remains the practical path; overseas-first activation is not established.
data.kyc: Passport/identity registration is reported by current independent Georgia SIM guides.
data.payment: Local/online Cellfie purchase and top-up methods; foreign-payment acceptance not established.
data.roamingSms: eSIM roaming is supported, but inbound SMS pricing/continuity abroad remains unresolved.
data.refund: No post-cancellation recovery guarantee was found.
data.tariffSummary: 90-day non-use clock; from day 91 a GEL0.50/day fee can drain balance, followed by 45-day unilateral block and later cancellation.
